ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A certain scientific research vessel set out from Shanghai to conduct an investigation of the sea areas in the Southern Hemisphere. Read the hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole. <image1> What is the nature of the ocean current at M?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a Southern Hemisphere projection map centered on the South Pole, with “S” marked near the center, and concentric dashed latitude lines on the periphery; from the center downward there is a meridian pointing toward the outer circle, and “180°” and “P” are marked on the outside. Point M is located in the Southern Hemisphere high-latitude sea area outside the South Pole and near the 180° meridian. Then reason: the location of point M corresponds to the circumpolar sea area outside Antarctica, and the main ocean current is the West Wind Drift/Antarctic Circumpolar Current. This ocean current is in a high-latitude cold-water area and is affected by low-temperature seawater near Antarctica, so the water temperature is relatively low; therefore, its nature is a cold current.

<image1>

What is the nature of the ocean current at M?

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：这是以南极点为中心的南半球投影图，中心标有“S”，外圈和虚线纬线表示南半球高纬海域；M点位于南极洲外围、约180°经线附近的环南极海域。再读题干：问题只问“M处洋流的性质”。将图中M点所在位置对应到南半球中高纬的环南极洋流，即西风漂流/南极绕极流；该洋流位于高纬冷水区，并携带来自南极附近的低温海水，因此性质判定为寒流。

某科学考察船从上海出发，对南半球海域进行考察。读以南极点为中心的半球投影图。

<image1>

M处洋流的性质是什么？

Point M is located in the Southern Hemisphere high-latitude sea area outside the South Pole and near the 180° meridian. Then reason: the location of point M corresponds to the circumpolar sea area outside Antarctica, and the main ocean current is the West Wind Drift/Antarctic Circumpolar Current. This ocean current is in a high-latitude cold-water area and is affected by low-temperature seawater near Antarctica, so the water temperature is relatively low; therefore, its nature is a cold current.
